dict.string: Flowstate listens while you hold the Fn key and turns your speech into text, and transcribes meetings you choose to record. Audio is processed on your Mac and never stored.
Flowstate learns the names of your contacts so it spells them correctly when you dictate. Names stay on your Mac.
Flowstate learns meeting titles and attendee names from your calendar so it spells them correctly. They stay on your Mac.
Flowstate learns meeting titles and attendee names from your calendar so it spells them correctly. They stay on your Mac.
Flowstate records the audio of calls you choose to transcribe, so the other side appears in the meeting notes. It captures sound only, never your screen, and stores no audio.
